items.title: How I built a "chess-engine" style AI for a 6-dice strategy game natively on my Pixel 9 Pro
items.en_title: How I built a "chess-engine" style AI for a 6-dice strategy game natively on my Pixel 9 Pro
items.en_oneliner: A solo developer built an AI opponent for a six-dice tabletop game entirely on his phone, using chess-engine-style probability simulation instead of fixed rules — and teaching the AI to read the opponent’s scorecard and adjust its risk appetite on the fly.

items.title: Add Instant 'Game Feel' With This 6-Line JS Screen Shake & Hit-Stop Trick
items.en_title: Add Instant 'Game Feel' With This 6-Line JS Screen Shake & Hit-Stop Trick
items.en_oneliner: No physics engine needed: just six lines of canvas translation shake inside your render loop to make weapon hits and collisions in a 2D HTML5 browser game feel ten times heavier.

items.title: Fitting a whole game build into a URL fragment, stamped with the patch it was made for
items.en_title: Fitting a whole game build into a URL fragment, stamped with the patch it was made for
items.en_oneliner: A developer shows how to bit-pack a full game build — class, skills, and talent points — into a short URL fragment, and how to stamp each link with its patch version so old builds can flag what a later patch may have broken.

items.title: Defold release 1.14.1

items.title: [Browser/Telegram] Seraph Legion - a gothic angel-collector RPG that plays inside Telegram
items.en_title: [Browser/Telegram] Seraph Legion - a gothic angel-collector RPG that plays inside Telegram
items.en_oneliner: A solo dev shares this gothic angel-collector RPG that runs as a Telegram Mini App, where you summon fallen angels into a five-unit legion, push a stage campaign plus a daily 12-rite roguelite gauntlet, built on React + Fastify + Postgres with deterministic seeded battles replayed server-side to keep cheating out.
